official: 練馬区女性福祉資金貸付条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案の内容

name: 女性福祉資金の貸付上限額を引き上げ
summary: 事業開始資金や結婚資金などの貸付限度額を引き上げます。対象は、事業開始資金、事業継続資金、結婚資金と、医療介護資金、生活資金、修学資金、就学支度資金の一部です。施行日は公布の日です。
changes: 事業開始資金など7種類の貸付限度額を引き上げる
who: 女性福祉資金を利用する人
why: 東京都の条例改正を踏まえたものと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Raises maximum loan amounts for women’s welfare loans
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Women’s Welfare Loan Ordinance
en.summary: The maximum loan amounts will be raised for business start-up, business continuation and marriage funds, and for some medical and nursing care, living, school attendance and school preparation funds. The changes cover seven types of loans. The ordinance takes effect on the day it is promulgated.
changes: Raises the maximum loan amounts for seven types of funds, including business start-up funds
who: People who use women’s welfare loans
en.why: The ward says this is based on an amendment to a Tokyo Metropolitan Government ordinance.
